findings.statement: FLEX droplet visible-flame extinction is predictable from ambient conditions: a six-feature logistic model reaches grouped AUC 0.882 (recomputed; historical build recorded 0.875) vs 0.818 for an oxygen-only baseline on 262 clean microgravity tests.
findings.basis: PSI-69_FLEX.csv (274 rows, recovered from NASA PSI, sha256-verified); GroupKFold-4 by condition.
findings.caveat: Microgravity domain only; not a flammability or cabin-safety metric; uncalibrated score.

findings.statement: Oxygen partial pressure, not just O2 fraction, separates habitat atmospheres: the Moon-Base concept (10.2 psi, 30% O2) has ~43% higher O2 fraction than Earth reference but ~1% lower pO2 (21.1 vs 21.3 kPa).
findings.basis: Challenge-brief reference atmospheres (Earth 14.7 psi/21%; Moon concept <=10.2 psi/>=30% O2); computed via the equation registry.
findings.caveat: Atmosphere concepts are design references, not certified habitat standards.

findings.statement: CFI-G hot-ignition remains unsolved by pre-test features: the calibrated multivariate logistic model (grouped AUC 0.682) does not beat a single-feature oxygen baseline (0.728) on 146 labelled inverse-configuration tests.
findings.basis: PSI-159_CFI-G_Inverse.csv (154 rows, 8 flash-excluded); spec-preserved coefficients validated on recovered data (146/131 exact match).
findings.caveat: Exploratory; small negative class (15); fold instability 0.038-0.92; retained as honest negative result.

findings.statement: SPICE burn duration does not generalise from pre-test features: ridge (R2 -0.409) and gradient boosting (R2 -0.367) both fail to beat the per-fuel mean baseline under date-grouped validation.
findings.basis: PSI-107_SPICE.csv (469 rows, 34 duplicates counted); recorded negative result retained per spec.
findings.caveat: Timestamps are operator-logged; applicability limited to SPICE fuels/nozzles/flows.

findings.statement: Cool flames radically alter ignition/extinction behaviour: FLEX/CFI investigations documented radiatively-driven cool-flame extinction and re-ignition regimes not captured by classical hot-flame theory (see investigation objectives and publications).
findings.basis: PSI-69/PSI-39/PSI-159 PSI metadata: objectives, approach, publication lists (NASA-recorded).
findings.caveat: Qualitative synthesis of NASA-recorded investigation goals; not a new quantitative claim.

findings.statement: Large-scale spacecraft fire growth evidence is extremely scarce: SAFFIRE flight tables bundle only 4 (SAFFIRE-I), 15 (SAFFIRE-II) and 2 (SAFFIRE-III) summary rows respectively.
findings.caveat: Rows are experiment summaries, not the full instrument time-series; SAFFIRE-III is a two-row table and must not be inflated.

findings.statement: Smoke/aerosol measurement evidence spans three flight investigations (SAME, SAME-R, DAFT) targeting spacecraft smoke detector response characterisation.
findings.basis: PSI-101/PSI-102/PSI-47 metadata and tables (recovered from NASA PSI).
findings.caveat: Tables are small (109/8/2 rows); detector-response thresholds are not directly recorded in them.

findings.statement: Data duplication is real and must be surfaced: the recovered corpus contains 50 exact duplicate rows (SPICE 34, E-FIELD 8, CFI 8) out of 2,009 rows across 22 tables.
findings.basis: Recomputed in this rebuild (scripts/build_corpus.py); matches spec-recorded total of 50.
findings.caveat: Duplicates retained and displayed; removal would require per-case source review.
